The City Holding Company holds 39,670 shares with $6.66M value, up from 37,810 last quarter. Apple Inc Com now has $939.92 billion valuation. The stock decreased 0.25% or $0.47 during the last trading session, reaching $191.23. About 16.66M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 12, 2017 and is uptrending. Petrofac Limited, an oilfield service company, provides facilities solutions to the gas and oil production and processing industry worldwide. The company has market cap of 1.97 billion GBP. It operates through three divisions: Engineering & Construction, Engineering & Production Services, and Integrated Energy Services. It currently has negative earnings. The Engineering & Construction segment provides engineering, procurement, and construction project execution services to the onshore gas and oil industry.
